scope: Solana mainnet node RPC behavior only; not market-process completeness

payg.transport: authenticated Alchemy MCP app; calls are end-to-end tool latency, not isolated provider wire latency
payg.batching: not directly tested; MCP exposes one RPC per tool call
payg.rate_limit_observation: No HTTP/provider error among 228 calls; 33.68 requests/s is the maximum observed phase throughput, not a saturation threshold or plan limit.

free.transport: direct HTTPS JSON-RPC to separate Free Solana mainnet endpoint; credential omitted
free.capability: One HTTP JSON-RPC batch containing getVersion and getSlot returned both results; individual getSlot and getSignaturesForAddress(limit=1) calls also returned valid data.

getSignaturesForAddress_limit1_interval1.headers_on_429: not captured; a later separate HTTP 200 response had no Retry-After/X-RateLimit headers

free.free_account_usage_delta: unavailable from the connected Alchemy tools
free.interpretation: Observed 429s on signature lookup at low measured phase throughput. Their relationship to account-wide remaining quota or a method-specific limit is unresolved.

decision: Use Free for local development and low-volume basic RPC only when it remains error-free. Use PAYG for bounded indexed signature qualification while Free continues to return 429 under the tested request pattern.
not_established: provider failure rate over a representative period
PAYG saturation point or maximum sustained throughput
